column_description: A VARCHAR(30) primary key matching ABKey from AssessmentBasics (FK).
An enum (recoverystatus_enum) describing recovery status (Relapse, Stable, Advanced, Early).
An enum (socialsupportlevel_enum) measuring social support (Strong, Limited, Moderate).
An enum (familyinvolvement_enum) indicating family involvement level (Low, High, Medium).
An enum (relationshipquality_enum) describing overall relationship quality (Poor, Conflicted, Good, Fair).
An enum (workfunctioning_enum) referencing work functioning (Disabled, Poor, Fair, Good).
An enum (socialfunctioning_enum) referencing social functioning (Isolated, Fair, Good, Poor).
An enum (adlfunctioning_enum) describing ADL performance (Minimal Help, Independent, Moderate Help, Dependent).
A NUMERIC(3,1) measuring perceived stress level (e.g., 6.0).
An enum (copingskills_enum) capturing coping skill quality (Good, Poor, Fair, Limited).
A NUMERIC(3,1) measuring resilience (e.g., 5.5).
An enum (insightlevel_enum) describing insight (Fair, Good, Poor).
An enum (motivationlevel_enum) referencing motivation (High, Low, Medium).
An enum (primarydx_enum) for the primary diagnosis (Anxiety, PTSD, Bipolar, Schizophrenia, Depression).
An enum (secondarydx_enum) for secondary diagnosis (OCD, Personality Disorder, Substance Use, Eating Disorder).
A SMALLINT specifying diagnosis duration in months (e.g., 12).
A SMALLINT counting past hospitalizations (e.g., 2).
A DATE capturing the date of the last hospitalization (e.g., '2025-01-10').
A SMALLINT measuring Quality of Life score (0–100).
An enum (functionalimpairment_enum) describing functional impairment (Severe, Moderate, Mild).
